No.C-Ex/Misc/Comp.audit/2009 Dated:

All Additional CPFCs (Zones)
All RPFCs (In-charge of the Regions/SROs)

Sub:-' Notification in two schemes of EPF & MP Act, 1952 for (i) Employees’
Pension (Third Amendment Scheme, 2005) for international workers’(Il)
EPF (Third Amendment) Scheme, 2008 for International Workers.

Ref:- i) Head Office letter No. Coord/2(27)/Amend/Scheme/Part/59817 dt. 14/11/08

ii) Head Office letter No. Coord/5(15)/09/International Worker dt. 25/11/10
Sir,

Kindly refer to Head Office letters referred above vide which Gazette Notifications
no. GSR 706(E) dt. 01/10/08 & GSR 148 (E) dt. 03/08/10 respectively were forwarded
to all RPFCs in-charge of ROs/SROs with the request to ensure that exempted trust
funds in your jurisdiction should also suitably modify their schemes and ensure
compliance. °
2 You are requested to ensure that necessary action for inserting the relevant
clause with respect to International Workers in the P.F trust rules of the exempted
establishments in your jurisdiction is ensured and an action taken report is submitted to
this office.

Yours faithfully,

plage

(P.K. Agarwal)
Regional P.F. Commissioner-I(Exemption)
